description: Hand-reviewed resolutions for Figma names the generator can't confirm on its own (join step 1, checked before every other rule). `token: null` records a deliberate 'this stays figma-only' decision instead of a mapping. generate.mjs fails if a `token` doesn't exist in the installed Paragon, or if `expect` no longer matches that token's resolved value (the override may be stale). See policy.md § 'How a candidate gets resolved'.

overrides.reason: text/primary is Figma's name for default body text color. --pgn-color-body-base is Paragon's body-text token (aliases to gray-700 today), not the gray-700 primitive directly, so a brand that changes the body color independently of gray-700 stays correct.
